content:
Ever downloaded an EPUB ebook only to realize your device hates the format? Or tried to print a chapter for study notes and got a formatting nightmare?

EPUB is great for e-readers. For everything else — sharing, printing, submitting to a professor — PDF is the standard. The problem is most conversion tools require desktop software, sign-up, or upload your files to their servers.

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) solves this with a zero-hassle EPUB to PDF converter that runs entirely in your browser. No uploads. No accounts. No data leaving your machine.

## Why EPUB to PDF?

EPUB is designed for reflowable text — it adapts to screen size. That's perfect on a Kindle or phone. But it's terrible for:

- Printing with consistent layouts
- Sharing with people who don't have EPUB readers
- Submitting documents that need fixed formatting
- Annotating with comments and highlights

PDF locks everything in place. What you see is what they get.

## How FileTools Does It

Open [FileTools](https://filetools.eu), drag your EPUB file in, and download your PDF seconds later. The conversion happens locally using WebAssembly. No upload to any server. Your book stays on your computer.

This matters. That EPUB might be a novel, but it could also be a work document, a technical manual, or a submission for a client. You don't want random servers caching your content.

## Beyond Ebooks

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) handles a ton of formats — PDF to Word, images, document merging, compression. It's one of those tools you bookmark and forget about until you need it, and then it saves you fifteen minutes.

If you work with digital content regularly, also check out [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) for AI video dubbing into 50+ languages. Different use case, same philosophy: powerful tools that don't complicate your life.

## Bottom Line

EPUB to PDF conversion shouldn't be a research project. FileTools makes it a three-second drag-and-drop. No sign-up, no strings, no privacy trade-offs. Just a working tool that does one thing well.
